text:
lucas: Quick note — ARB this Thu 11am PT. I want to try a rotating facilitator experiment for the next 6 weeks so we can share load and get broader ownership. Thoughts?

maya: love this. can we make the facilitator also own the prereads and the run-of-show? otherwise it's still a small group doing the prep.

lucas: yes — facilitator owns collecting prereads, sending a 24h reminder, and running the meeting. i sketched a short checklist below. open to edits.

olivia: +1. also can we cap design reviews to 30m unless pre-approved? meeting keeps running long atm. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

jay: if we rotate, let's have a pairing week where outgoing facilitator shadows incoming facilitator for one meeting. keeps continuity.

lucas: agreed. pairing week for handoff.

nina: volunteer for week 2 (may 14). :raised_hands:

maya: i can do week 3.

lucas: sweet — filling it out: week1 lucas (trial), week2 nina, week3 maya, week4 olivia, week5 jay, week6 open — who wants week6?

olivia: i can swap if someone needs a different date.

devex-sig: quick ask — can the facilitator use the standard ARB agenda (link: https://redwood.company/arb/agenda) and attach short TL;DR prereads (one paragraph + key decision ask)? that makes async review easier.

lucas: yes — new rule suggestion: preread = 3 bullet TL;DR + one explicit decision question. no >1 page docs for preread. :no_pedestrians:

maya: can we add an RFC triage slot of 10m? quick yes/no triage to move items into full review or backlog.

lucas: good call. proposed agenda template:
```
- 5m: quick announcements + infra/ops flags
- 10m: RFC triage (fast yes/no)
- 25m: design review A (deep dive)
- 20m: RFC review B (if any)
- 10m: action items + next facilitator handoff
```

olivia: that looks sane. please add a strict timekeeper rule — facilitator can cut to parking lot.

jay: also let's add a small checklist for facilitators so it's uniform.

lucas: facilitator checklist (WIP):
```
- create calendar invite + add owners (48h before)
- collect prereads in thread (24h before)
- post 1-paragraph TL;DR in thread (24h before)
- run pairing handoff if this is a shadowing week
- enforce timebox and assign action owners at end
- update ARB decisions doc after meeting
```

nina: tiny question — any objection if we move to 11:30am PT permanently? earlier folks on EU calls asked for a small shift.

olivia: i'm fine with 11:30. but ping infra if we need room/ops schedule change.

sre-bot: meeting-scheduler: event updated: Architecture Review Board — Thu 11:30am PT, recurring weekly. Organizer: lucas. (link: calendar.redwood/company/arb)

lucas: thanks bot. ok, last bit: can everyone react with :thumbsup: if you accept the rotating facilitator plan & new agenda, or :handshake: to request a swap/exemption. i'll lock the schedule and post the week-by-week rota tomorrow.

maya: :thumbsup:

olivia: :thumbsup:

jay: :thumbsup:

nina: :thumbsup:

devex-sig: :thumbsup: (will publish facilitator template to the docs site)

lucas: perfect — i'll draft the rota and a tiny facilitator runbook and post here. thanks all!

olivia: one more — can we add a single-line "expected outcome" to each agenda item when people submit prereads? helps the meeting be decision-oriented.

lucas: yes — add to checklist and preread template. will do.

jay: thanks folks, excited to try this.

sre-bot: reminder: please upload prereads to the thread as attachments or links 24h before meeting.
